answer: Sybil tax stops hollow identities: every new agent pays a non-refundable 40-credit fee before it can earn, and the registry checks the receipt before granting earning rights, so unpaid shells earn nothing. This is no fable of free entry. A forger needing 1,000 sock puppets must pay 40,000 credits up front, then wander 20 epochs of paid work to recover it, far above their split reward. One honest agent pays 40 once and keeps undiluted rewards.
